newsitem.title: UK: Gotaas-Larsen no comment on bid by Osprey Maritime.
newsitem.headline: Gotaas-Larsen no comment on bid by Osprey Maritime.

text.p: Monaco-based oil and gas carrier operator Gotaas-Larsen today declined to confirm reports that Singapore-listed Osprey Maritime Ltd was seeking to acquire it for between US$500 million and $650 million.
The two companies already have a joint operation involving the 129,000 cubic metre LNG carrier Golar Spirit.
Speculation about a deal between the two has been growing for the past two weeks.
Osprey Maritime did not comment Friday on the reports but on a separate issue said today it had initiated arbitration against OMI Promise Tankers Inc for failing to deliver a vessel.
Under the original sales terms, OMI Promise Tankers was expected to deliver "Osprey Promise", re-named Kartika Ayu, to Osprey Maritime.
The Singapore shipping group acquired the eight strong product tanker fleet of Oslo-based Petrobulk Group last year.
